package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestStoredDiagnosticPlacementBindsExactResultDigestAndConsumeHash(t *testing.T) {
	plan := placementTestPlan(t)
	result := DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1, StudentID: plan.StudentID, CourseID: plan.CourseID, CourseContentRevision: plan.CourseRevision, PolicyVersion: plan.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: plan.ID, PlanID: plan.ID, PlanRevision: plan.PlanRevision, Correct: 3, Total: 3, Percent: 100, Band: "ADVANCED", BandPolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest, CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	result.ResultDigest, _ = DiagnosticResultDigest(result)
	decision := DiagnosticPlacement{Schema: DiagnosticPlacementSchemaV1, StudentID: result.StudentID, CourseID: result.CourseID, CourseContentRevision: result.CourseContentRevision, PolicyVersion: result.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: result.AttemptID, PlanID: result.PlanID, PlanRevision: result.PlanRevision, Correct: result.Correct, Total: result.Total, Percent: result.Percent, Band: result.Band, BandPolicyVersion: result.BandPolicyVersion, PlanDigest: result.PlanDigest, ResultDigest: result.ResultDigest, ResultCompletedAt: result.CompletedAt, RouteCode: "START_ADVANCED", RoutePolicyVersion: DiagnosticPlacementRoutePolicyV1, DecidedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	decision.DecisionDigest, _ = DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	hash, _ := DiagnosticPlacementConsumeHash(plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
	if ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(decision, plan, plan.ID, hash, decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
		t.Fatal("valid decision rejected")
	}
	decision.ResultDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)
	decision.DecisionDigest, _ = DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	if ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(decision, plan, plan.ID, hash, decision.DecisionDigest) == nil {
		t.Fatal("forged result digest accepted")
	}
	decision.ResultDigest = result.ResultDigest
	decision.DecisionDigest, _ = DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	if ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(decision, plan, plan.ID, "sha256:"+strings.Repeat("c", 64), decision.DecisionDigest) == nil {
		t.Fatal("forged request hash accepted")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogAndRequestRejectAliases(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticPlanRequest(DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestSchemaV1, StudentID: " 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("request alias accepted")
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticCatalog(DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: " course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1", CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Revision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("schema alias accepted")
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeDiagnosticCatalog(DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchemaV1, CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Revision: "SHA256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("revision case alias accepted")
	}
}

func placementTestPlan(t *testing.T) DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	t.Helper()
	plan := DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), CourseRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	for n := 0; n < 3; n++ {
		plan.Assessments = append(plan.Assessments, DiagnosticAssessment{LessonID: fmt.Sprintf("44444444-4444-4444-8444-%012d", n), TaskID: fmt.Sprintf("55555555-5555-4555-8555-%012d", n), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: n})
	}
	plan.PlanDigest, _ = DiagnosticPlanDigest(plan)
	return plan
}
